## Person

**Name:** Hasil Paudyal
**Location:** Kathmandu, Nepal
**Website:** https://hasilpaudyal.com.np
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/hasil/
**GitHub:** https://github.com/ha5il
**Facebook:** https://facebook.com/hasill

**Bio:** Not always starting from A ends you in Z, sometimes you have to continue with AA and create any word of your own. With a background in Electrical Engineering, Hasil has expertise in design, web development, management, electrical repair, electronics simulation, IoT hardware, and creative writing. He writes original poems and quotes, and has built and shipped mobile apps to the App Store and Google Play.

---

## Career History

### App Development Manager — ConvergeStack, Kathmandu (Jan 2022 – Present)
As project lead, specialises in hybrid app development using React Native (Expo), from prototyping to publishing production-ready Android and iOS apps. Manages servers and assists the backend team with architectural decisions and algorithm implementation. Builds custom native modules in Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android).

### Web Developer — View9, Nepal (Jan 2019 – Dec 2021, 2 years 11 months)
Led backend development for websites, integrating server-to-server APIs for banks, license verification, online payments, and other services using SOAP and JSON. Developed logging, scheduling, and recurring job systems for notifications using AWS and Laravel. Mentored junior team members in server setup and production issue handling.

### Part-time Junior Android Developer — Fixolla, India (Feb 2018 – Dec 2018, 11 months)
Worked with the Android development team on app and API development.

### Part-time Security Analyst — Fixolla, India (Sep 2017 – Feb 2018, 6 months)
Assisted in data scraping from open sources to build company databases. Participated in public speaking and promotional activities at colleges in Bangalore.

### Service and Sales Engineer — A2Z Laundry Solutions, India (Dec 2016 – Dec 2018, 2 years 1 month)
Set up and expanded laundry businesses across India. Authorised service engineer for Danube International (France), Pony (Italy), SEKO (USA), Electrolux (Sweden), Maytag (USA), Speedqueen (USA), Hydrosystems (USA), SEITZ (Germany), and Sunrise (India).

## Education

**B.E. Electrical Engineering** — New Horizon College of Engineering, Bangalore (2013–2017)

## IT Projects

### BriefBoard
KPI dashboard mobile app published on App Store and Google Play. Built with React Native / Expo. Displays business metrics and key performance indicators.
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/id/app/briefboard/id6757684014
Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.convergestack.briefboard

### Legal Remit
Real-time international remittance web platform. Technologies: Laravel, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, RDS, S3.

### VoIP Calls
SIP and WebRTC based call app with custom Expo native modules written in Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android). Local IP based calling.

### KTM Retail (Jockey / Dixey Nepal)
E-commerce website for Jockey and Dixey Nepal. Technologies: Vue.js, Laravel.

### Intranery
Online stationery and multi-product marketplace for dealers, similar to Daraz. Aimed at door-to-door delivery across Nepal. Technologies: Vue.js, Laravel.

### Strata Tender Management
Tender creation and bidding portal. Technologies: Laravel, Vue.js, AWS.

### Community Events
React Native app for creating, inviting, and enjoying community events. Technologies: React Native, Backend API, Frontend.

### Limbu English-Nepali Dictionary
Free online dictionary for searching Limbu meanings in English and Nepali. Technologies: Native Framework, WordPress.

### Foreveryng
Online beauty store for Nepal. E-commerce website. Technologies: Vue.js, Laravel, API.

### Kourtier Courier
Web app for courier tracking management. Technologies: Vue.js, Laravel, Teammates.

### Discont Card
Discounts, coupons, and entertainment for every age group. Technologies: Vue.js, API, Backend, Merchant integrations.

### Indigo Ink
Book gallery page for a book publisher with events management. Technologies: Laravel, PHP.

### Short Vids
Short entertaining videos app to make your day. Technologies: Vue.js.

### Mero Pharmacist
Pharma SRS and online enquiry platform.

### CMS Website
Content management website for Nepal.

### Employee Records Directory
Employee records directory built with Laravel and Vue.js.

### Amour Production House
Website for a production house built with OctoberCMS.

### Reachon
Digital education platform with real-time features. Technologies: Vue.js, Socket.io, Nepal.

### Fixolla India
Website for Fixolla — simplifying lives through repair services (mobile, tablet, laptop).

---

## Electrical & Electronics Projects

### RFID Limiter — Arduino Uno
Portable hardware device that limits the frequency of RFID scans. Built with Arduino Uno, RFID reader, and custom firmware.

### RABC Analyser — Windows Console App
Windows console application for analysing Danube International washer extractor data. RABC = Risk Analysis and Biocontamination Control.

### Electricity Thief Automatic Remover
Circuit that automatically detects and disconnects electricity theft from supply lines.

### Electrical Device Performance Tracker
Real-time analyser and tracker for electrical device performance metrics.

## Original Poems by Hasil Paudyal

### It's Me (Acrostic: H.A.S.I.L. P.A.U.D.Y.A.L.)

Here I am / A cut above you all / Silent as a grave / In favour of your death

Lethal is my pen / Perfect would be again / A fortune is with me / Unbeatable this shall be

Dare you come near / Yell you out there / And who is this me / Links the first letters to me

---

### Why Fail

Everyone listen what I Tell, / Why I always get Fail? / The school is Hell / To make me Fail!

Teachers scold Me, / And friends hate Me / Just because Why / I was going to Die...

I tried my Best / To get Success, / But that study as Input / Gave me red marks as Output

Even I got fail this Time / I may top next Time / What if you hate Me / World may again love Me

Give me another Chance / Then, / You will Get / Less than I Gain...

---

### Greed, Love, Genius and Peace

The world doesn't seems to be greedy / You are the one who feels greedy / If you think that I am greedy / Then remember I am greedy because you are greedy

Don't think that I don't love you / Until and unless you know that I love you / If you think that I love you / Then you should know that I don't hate you

If you know that I am genius / Then know that you made of genius / Everyone don't accept me as genius / Because they aren't genius to belief me as genius

Try to live always in peace / So that I can stay in peace / To live in peace, know the meaning of peace / Dictionary is right there, go and find the word - peace.

---

### What This Moment Is?

I never wish of getting you / But I always meet you / Wherever I move from / It leads up to you

I want to say what my eyes says / So always stay around you / But my nervousness stops / To get near of you

Wish you could know my hidden words / And accept my proposal for my happiness / Which takes to your happiness / And finally to our home happiness

At least I said you hi today / Now waiting for your reply tomorrow / What this moment is? Am so confused / Neither want to gain nor to loose...

---

### Take Me Out

Dreaming of getting you / I loosed everything / Cheerfulness of smile / And all the dreams of life

Wishing of being yours / Followed you a lot / But got you only with / Someone others

May be its mine bad-luck / Or yours not to get me / But I still have hope / Of being yours

Give me a break / I'll explain you everything / What's the truth / And what's the false

Please understand me / Trust me and help me / To get out of this puzzle / Forever

---

### My Dream Girl

My sound never goes sharper, / Never goes shriller, / When I speak with you,

Coz you are my love, / You are my love; / The crazy feelings of me, / Crazy feelings of me towards you,

Are never gonna change, / Coz you are mine, / And only mine; / Though I can't face you,

Though I can't face you, / In front of everyone, / Coz you are my dream, / Coz you are my dream;

Oh God! please don't let this dream go, / Please God! don't let this dream go, / Coz in this dream there is mine DREAM GIRL, / There is mine DREAM GIRL......

---

### Leave Me Alone

What do you think you yourself are, leader of my heart? / Who do you think you are, someone for whom I can die?

If so, then stop thinking the false! / Your dreams can never get true / I don't remember you, crazy for me / At least someone can really be the same for me

If you didn't love me, you really are a good actress / But if you really do, better let me forget it as you never loved me

Days were in past where I waited for you / But its the present, time to forget you / I don't care what you shall do / I only remember what I should do

Stay in dark without me / And I shall Stay in light without you / Get out of the heart / And never ever dare to come again here

---

### Concord

Came in Earth alone / And will be going alone / But, / Needs someone to remove solitariness / So, I am in search of fondness / Wish / Come and understand me / Come and help me / Come and assist me / And finally tag me

Wish you'll shield me / And I'll too secure you / So, proceed together / We'll to victory. / Thus, I am in search of affinity

Take me away from jinx / Take me away from junk / Neutralise my vandalize / Wish I'll retrieve soon

---

### Current Aim

I should get it whatever it costs / But within few months / If it slips off my hands / I may not get its glance

Everyone is helping me to get it / And I am too trying me best to achieve it / Wish this time my luck supports me / And my heart gains it

If I fail this time / I need to try next time / But my pens will scold me / My book will hate me

So request god to gain success / And help me to cross IRON GATE / I am sure I won't make it rust / Thus help me my host

---

### Happy New Year Sunshine

Here it comes / A new year again / But glass of wine / Weeks in my lifeline

Waiting for your ego / To beat a bye bye go / Waiting for conversation / Holding for brightening realization

The story is old / With a new scent / I promise that / There shall never be any bend

You are the Sunshine / The best Sunshine / Shining my every year / Happy New Year
